answer: A sybil tax stops fake identities at the gate: each new agent pays a non-refundable entry fee equal to twice its expected 30-day earnings, burned on entry. Forging 100 fakes costs 200 months of earnings for nothing, while an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards. The fee is published on a crystal-clear ledger and steps down a terrace of tiers over 20 epochs of honest work; a black onyx seal marks it, and renting one slashes both.
